<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Triage a case"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/exceptions/{caseId}/triage"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sets or changes the severity and queue of a case that is not yet
resolved, and moves an `OPEN` case to `TRIAGED`. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`; replaying the same key and body returns the stored
response. Publishes `ExceptionTriaged`.


<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

Required on every POST and PUT; answered with\n400 `idempotency-key-required` when absent. A replay with the same\nkey and the same body returns the stored response; the same key with\na different body is a 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128}},{"name":"caseId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The case id (`case-` followed by a unique suffix, at most 64 characters).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":6,"maxLength":64,"pattern":"^case-[^\\s/]+$"},"example":"case-1d2e3f4a-5b6c-4789-9abc-def012345678"}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
